name: technical-test
description: Solar telemetry with an Express API, Vue dashboard, scheduled CSV collection, cleanup, and SQL assessment.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend,simulator "npm run dev -w @technical-test/backend" "npm run dev -w @technical-test/frontend" "npm run dev -w @technical-test/telemetry-simulator"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @technical-test/backend && npm run build -w @technical-test/telemetry-simulator && npm run build -w @technical-test/automation && npm run build -w @technical-test/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @technical-test/backend && npm run typecheck -w @technical-test/telemetry-simulator && npm run typecheck -w @technical-test/automation && npm run typecheck -w @technical-test/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @technical-test/backend && npm run test -w @technical-test/telemetry-simulator && npm run test -w @technical-test/automation && npm run test -w @technical-test/frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @technical-test/backend && npm run lint -w @technical-test/telemetry-simulator && npm run lint -w @technical-test/automation && npm run lint -w @technical-test/frontend
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
